Fragment_080d5094 begins mid-stream with a plain `bl` and reads r7/r8/r10/r11 as already-live values with no corresponding formal parameters an ordinary ABI-compliant C function could receive them through. Internal edges labelled `sub_080d4e4c`, `sub_080d4ece`, `sub_080d4fe0` (conditional/unconditional branches, not `bl`) land inside Region_080d4ce8's own byte range with the same live register state, which only type-checks if both owners are one physical C function; a standalone `void Func_080d5094(void)` cannot reproduce that entry state or exit through a shared caller frame it never allocated.

refuted_hypotheses: Treating Fragment_080d5094 as a self-contained void function with plausible locals for r7/r8/r10/r11: compiles to a 2-byte `bx lr` stub, 226 differing halfwords against reference, because GCC has no source-level way to seed those registers with caller-supplied live values without formal parameters, and the required epilogue frame (sp-64, r8-r11) was never allocated by this owner.
